item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 28/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will weaken slightly in the next couple of days, but the weather will still be very hot over southeastern China. Besides, the tropical disturbance now over the central to northern part of the South China Sea will edge closer to the coast of southeastern China gradually today and tomorrow. Under the influence of the disturbance and a southwesterly airstream, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The subtropical ridge will strengthen again early to midweek next week. The weather will be persistently very hot over southeastern China.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. More showers with a few squally thunderstorms in the morning. Very hot with sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
